project.name: lending-platform
project.description: Reactor/aggregator build for the lending microservices. `mvn clean package` from this directory builds every module below in one pass. This POM deliberately does NOT act as the Maven parent of either module -- each keeps its own spring-boot-starter-parent for dependency management (lending-service targets Java 21, lending-batch-service targets Java 17 -- independent settings, unaffected by aggregation here). Add a new microservice by dropping it in as a sibling directory and listing it below; nothing else about its own pom.xml needs to change.
